attributes.name: The Third Law
attributes.powers:
When you examine this card, encounter it.

Display this card next to the scenario; it is defeated. While displayed, when a location is permanently closing, before closing, roll 1d6. If the result exceeds the number of cards remaining in that location deck, a character at that location banishes a card or each character buries a card, then banish this card.

corrections.corrected_text: On the barriers The Second Law and The Third Law, add the Trigger trait.
corrections.issue: The First Law has the Trigger trait. Should The Second Law and The Third Law also have the Trigger trait?
